import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.resource import Rows
from src.service import stream_rows
r = Rows([1, 2, 3])
assert list(stream_rows(r, lambda value: value * 2)) == [2, 4, 6]
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (4, 1)

from src.consumer import take

def rows(n=3): return Rows(range(1, n + 1))

# unstarted: no read/close
r = rows(); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); g.close()
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (0, 0)
# explicit close after start, closes once
r = rows(); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); assert next(g) == 1
g.close(); g.close()
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (1, 1)
# transform error: propagates, no more reads, one close
r = rows()
def bad(v):
    if v == 2: raise ValueError("t")
    return v
g = stream_rows(r, bad); assert next(g) == 1
try: next(g); raise SystemExit("no error")
except ValueError: pass
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
assert list(g) == []
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
# original error preserved when cleanup also fails
class BadClose(Rows):
    def close(self):
        super().close(); raise RuntimeError("c")
r = BadClose([1, 2])
g = stream_rows(r, bad)
try: list(g); raise SystemExit("no error")
except ValueError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
# cleanup error propagates on exhaustion and on close
r = BadClose([1]); 
try: list(stream_rows(r, lambda v: v)); raise SystemExit("no error")
except RuntimeError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
r = BadClose([1, 2]); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); next(g)
try: g.close(); raise SystemExit("no error")
except RuntimeError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
# read error
class BadRead(Rows):
    def read_next(self): raise KeyError("r")
r = BadRead([1])
try: list(stream_rows(r, lambda v: v)); raise SystemExit("no error")
except KeyError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
# take
r = rows(5); assert take(r, lambda v: v * 10, 2) == [10, 20]
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
r = rows(); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 0) == [] and (r.reads, r.closes) == (0, 0)
r = rows(2); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 5) == [1, 2] and r.closes == 1
r = rows()
try: take(r, bad, 3); raise SystemExit("no error")
except ValueError: pass
assert r.closes == 1
